tasks.short: Answer site managers and budget holders on accounting, budget and spending rules, and steer cost control.

steps.what: Receive and sort questions from budget holders by mail and Teams
Look up policy text and cost-centre budget position
inputs: budget vs actual by cost centre

steps.what: Write the answer or guidance note with the rule and the numbers

loop.input: Question text, retrieved handbook sections, cost-centre budget figures
loop.output: Draft answer citing handbook section and figures, or 'escalate'
loop.check: Every claim must cite a handbook section id; figures are inserted by code, not by the model; controller approves first-of-kind answers
loop.stop: One draft per question, one retry if citation check fails, else route to controller unanswered
loop.why_not_simpler: Questions arrive as free text in varied wording; a fixed FAQ menu does not match them reliably.

steps.what: Advise site managers in budget meetings on cost control and trade-offs
inputs: budget vs actual by cost centre

steps.what: Add recurring answers to the policy FAQ on SharePoint

tasks.design: A Teams intake form replaces loose mails and tags each question with cost centre and topic. A small answer desk on the Microsoft 365 tenant retrieves the finance handbook from SharePoint and pulls budget-vs-actual from the nightly AFAS extract, drafts a cited answer, and the controller approves new kinds of answers; approved ones feed a FAQ.
tasks.previous_blocker: The handbook was scattered across SharePoint files and the controller held the context in their head; retrieval over free-text questions was not reliable enough.
tasks.enabler_now: Retrieval with citations over a small document set works well, and the AFAS extract already exists for Power BI.
tasks.still_hard: Handbook must be kept current and unambiguous; questions that are really negotiations about budget stay human.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing when a site manager needs a firm no versus room to act, and building the trust that makes budget holders follow the rules.

ambition.what: Team leads in Tilburg and Venlo warehouses with small spending authority get same-day answers on what they may spend.

tasks.altitude: Fewer interruptions; the controller spends time in budget conversations and owns the handbook and the answer approval rules.

reach.task: Budget vs actual reporting per cost centre
reach.learn: Which budget questions repeat, to improve the forecast and dashboard.

evidence.claim: Retrieval-based answer desks with citations over a policy set are a standard pattern.
Prompts and outputs must live in a governed place, not a personal account, so answers can be rebuilt later.

assumptions: The finance handbook exists on SharePoint in some form.
Cost-centre budgets are loaded in AFAS or the Power BI model.
unknowns: How many questions per month reach the controller and from whom.
Whether budget figures are visible to site managers today.
research_questions: What share of last quarter's questions to the controller could be answered from the handbook alone?
Do budget holders accept a drafted answer if it cites the rule?
Is the handbook complete enough to answer the top 20 questions?

tasks.short: Analyse past and forecast results per site and customer to find cost savings and improvement areas.

steps.what: Export ledger, cost-centre and agency cost data into Excel
Build variance, trend and unit-cost views per site and customer
Investigate causes of large variances

loop.input: Variances above materiality with underlying journal lines and descriptions
loop.output: Draft flux commentary per variance with the top driving lines
loop.check: Code verifies that cited amounts sum to the variance; controller edits or rejects
loop.stop: Only variances above threshold; one draft each; if lines do not reconcile, mark 'unexplained' for the controller
loop.why_not_simpler: Journal descriptions and invoice texts are free text; grouping them into a cause needs reading.

steps.what: Write findings and improvement proposals for the finance director

loop.input: Approved variance explanations and dashboard figures
loop.output: Draft memo with findings and options
loop.check: Figures are pulled by code from the dashboard; controller rewrites recommendations
loop.stop: One draft per month; controller owns final text
loop.why_not_simpler: A template fills numbers, but the narrative must be written fresh each month.

steps.what: Discuss proposals with finance director and site managers

tasks.design: Replace the monthly Excel build with a scheduled Python job on a governed data platform that joins the AFAS ledger with agency hours and invoices and feeds a Power BI margin and unit-cost dashboard per site and customer. A bounded model step drafts flux commentary for variances above materiality, with a code check that amounts tie, and the controller edits before anything reaches the finance director.
tasks.previous_blocker: Agency portals and AFAS were only tied together by hand in Excel, so analysis came late and only per quarter.
tasks.enabler_now: AI coding makes the data job and dashboard cheap to build; models can draft variance commentary that code can check.
tasks.still_hard: Allocating shared warehouse and transport costs to customers is a policy choice; agency portal data quality varies.
tasks.human_edge: Judging which savings are real and which hurt service or safety, and convincing site managers to act.

ambition.what: A monthly margin review per customer contract instead of a yearly one, to catch loss-making contracts before renewal.

tasks.altitude: The controller stops building spreadsheets and spends the time on two or three improvement cases a month; owns materiality thresholds and cost allocation keys.

reach.learn: Use actual unit costs per site to set forecast drivers.
Which coding errors distort site costs.

evidence.claim: Model-drafted flux commentary with a deterministic tie-out gate is the recommended pattern for close work.
Accountants using AI closed the month 7.5 days faster in 79 small and mid-sized firms.
Close-task benchmarks show judgement, not retrieval, is the bottleneck.

assumptions: Agency portals allow export or API access to hours and invoices.
AFAS cost centres map to sites.
unknowns: Whether customer-level revenue and cost can be linked in AFAS today.
Which data platform IT allows for finance data.
research_questions: Can the three agency portals deliver hours and invoices in a machine-readable form?
How often did last year's variance commentary change after review?
Does management want per-customer margins monthly, and would they act on them?

tasks.short: Coordinate the year-end audit and internal checks so accounts meet Dutch law and tax rules.

steps.what: Plan audit with external auditor and agree the request list
Collect evidence: ledger exports, invoices, contracts, bank statements
Run control tests: duplicates, IBAN changes, approvals, segregation of duties
Review exceptions and agree corrections or adjustments
Answer auditor queries and management letter points

loop.input: Auditor query text and linked evidence pack items
loop.output: Draft response with references to evidence files
loop.check: Each reference must resolve to a file in the pack; controller approves before sending
loop.stop: One draft per query; if no evidence found, flag as open item
loop.why_not_simpler: Auditor queries are free text and must be matched to the right evidence.

tasks.design: A scheduled job builds the auditor's request list into an evidence pack from AFAS, SharePoint and Rabobank statements and runs fixed control tests all year (duplicate payments, IBAN changes, approvals over limit, segregation of duties) into a Power BI exception view. A bounded model step drafts responses to auditor queries with file references; the controller decides on adjustments and signs off responses.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence gathering and control tests were done once a year by hand because ad-hoc AFAS exports were tedious to repeat.
tasks.enabler_now: AI coding makes repeatable export and test scripts cheap; AFAS bank matching already runs on fixed rules, so tests can focus on what remains.
tasks.still_hard: Dutch GAAP judgements and VAT and wage tax positions are untested for AI drafting; auditors must accept the evidence trail.
tasks.human_edge: Judging materiality and negotiating with the auditor on adjustments and management letter wording.

ambition.what: Monthly control testing instead of once-a-year findings at the audit.

tasks.altitude: Audit season shrinks to review and negotiation; the controller owns the control test set and materiality and gets findings monthly.

reach.task: Supplier master changes and payment runs
reach.learn: Which IBAN-change and duplicate checks block a payment.
How wage tax postings are tested at audit.

evidence.claim: AFAS bank matching uses fixed rules on reference, IBAN and invoice number.
Estimates the auditor cannot rebuild are a known failure when AI work sits in personal accounts.
Tax estimates need mandatory human review and timestamped logs.
Large companies file accounts with KVK via SBR from FY2025, which AFAS cannot do for them.

assumptions: Noordhaven is audited by an external accountant under BW 2 Titel 9.
AFAS authorisation data can be exported.
unknowns: Which audit firm and what evidence format they accept.
research_questions: Will the auditor rely on automated control test output and evidence packs?
How many hours did last year's audit requests take the finance team?
Which control failures appeared in the last two management letters?

tasks.short: Write and maintain internal control policies for budgets, cash, credit and accounting.

steps.what: Identify control gaps from audit findings, incidents and process changes
Draft policy and procedure text

loop.input: Gap list, current handbook, house template
loop.output: Redline of the affected handbook sections
loop.check: Controller reviews redline; code checks that limits and roles match the authorisation matrix
loop.stop: One draft per gap; controller rewrites if off target
loop.why_not_simpler: Policy text must be written and fitted into existing wording; a template only gives structure.

steps.what: Consult finance director, site managers and IT; approve
Set approval workflows, limits and mandates in AFAS
Publish policy and train budget holders

tasks.design: Keep the finance handbook as one versioned SharePoint library tied to the AFAS authorisation matrix and a mandate register. Audit and control-test exceptions feed a gap list; a bounded model step drafts redlines, code checks limits against the matrix, and approved changes are configured as AFAS approval workflows and pushed to budget holders as a short Studytube module.
tasks.previous_blocker: Policies lived as loose Word files, out of sync with AFAS workflow settings, so updates were rare and slow.
tasks.enabler_now: Drafting redlines is fast with a model, and a script can compare policy limits with AFAS settings.
tasks.still_hard: Agreement with site managers on limits, and keeping AFAS configuration in step with the text.
tasks.human_edge: Choosing where control helps and where it only slows operations, and getting the finance director and sites to agree.

ambition.what: A mandate register that shows every budget holder their own signing limits, checked against AFAS each night.

tasks.altitude: Policy updates move from yearly to as-needed; the controller owns the authorisation matrix and the mandate register.

reach.learn: Where approval limits block or slip invoices.
How to track that budget holders completed control training.

evidence.claim: SAP's accruals agent works from a handbook and advises at most five expense categories per handbook, so policy structure matters.
Products draft and people review and approve, keeping records for audit.
Cash allocation and tax decisions need mandatory human approval with logs.

assumptions: AFAS approval workflows are in use for purchase invoices.
Studytube can host a short internal module.
unknowns: Whether a current authorisation matrix exists.
Whether any control policy touches staff monitoring and so needs OR consent.
research_questions: How far apart are current policy limits and AFAS workflow settings?
Would the finance director approve redlines drafted from a gap list?
Do budget holders know their own limits today?

role.altitude: From preparing the close and the audit by hand to designing the controls, thresholds and handbook that machines run on. The controller owns materiality, the authorisation matrix, tie-out checks and the audit trail; models write first drafts.
reach: FP&A Analyst: rolling forecast drivers from actual unit costs
Bookkeeper: invoice approval routing and supplier master checks
Accountant: audit evidence packs and month-end journals
Payroll Specialist: wage tax postings tested at audit
skills_to_grow: Specifying data jobs and tests on the AFAS extract
Setting materiality and tie-out rules for model drafts
Reviewing AI drafts efficiently and keeping an audit trail
role.ambitious_version: Continuous control: monthly control tests and per-customer margin reviews, a self-service policy desk for site team leads, and a mandate register checked nightly against AFAS, so the audit becomes a confirmation rather than a discovery.
